description: Authority matrix: maps each Actor to its allow-listed EventTypes. NON-SOVEREIGN dialogue/governance registry. DIVERGES from formal/LedgerKernel.v — see kernel_divergence below. Reconciliation pending.

kernel_divergence.headline: This registry does NOT mirror formal/LedgerKernel.v authority_ok_event_b.

axes.actor_count: kernel has 3 actors (HELEN, MAYOR, CHRONOS); registry has 6 (adds USER, BUILDER, INTEGRATOR for the dialogue/governance layer)
axes.event_type_count: kernel enumerates 10 event types; registry enumerates 9 (different vocabulary intersection)
axes.policy_shape: kernel uses a deny-list predicate (authority_ok_event_b returns false for forbidden combinations); registry uses an allow-list (each actor lists allowed_event_types)
axes.domain: kernel governs ledger-append authority structurally; registry governs dialogue-layer routing — they are NOT the same authority surface despite naming overlap

kernel_divergence.previous_claim_was_false: v1.0.0 header read 'Mirrors LedgerKernel.v authority_ok_event_b' and 'must match the Coq predicate exactly'. Both claims were false. F-002 axis B (2026-05-02) removed the false claim without yet reconciling the underlying drift — honesty before reconciliation (AUDIT_HONESTY doctrine, HELEN_OPERATIONAL_DISCIPLINE_V1 §5).

auditor: tools/audit_authority.py reads this file to validate plugin emitter actors. The auditor does NOT close axis B; it operates on this registry's allow-list shape only. See AXIS_B_CAVEAT in its output.

USER.description: Human initiator — can only query, cannot write assertions or claims

BUILDER.description: Agent that builds artifacts — can assert, query, and file task claims

INTEGRATOR.description: Agent that integrates subsystems — all BUILDER rights plus INTEGRATION events

CHRONOS.description: Temporal agent — can emit ticks and assertions, drives time-based events

HELEN.description: Conscious ledger agent — emits verdicts, receipts, and wisdom; cannot seal

MAYOR.description: Sole sovereign — emits verdicts, receipts, wisdom, and the terminal SEAL event

event_types.RECEIPT: Execution receipt binding a verdict to its claim
event_types.SEAL: Terminal event — closes the ledger run (MAYOR only)
event_types.TASK_CLAIM: Claim to perform or have performed a task
